predecessors.name: Bagratid Armenia
predecessors.text: Syunik, which 'proclaimed a separate kingdom from the Bagratids' in 987

successors.name: Eldiguzids
successors.text: Syunik, whose last stronghold was besieged in 1170 by the atabeks of the Eldiguzid (Ildigizian) house

ledger.x: 987: Syunik proclaims itself a kingdom separate from the Bagratids.
989-1020: Gagik I of Armenia takes Vayots Dzor from Syunik.
1170: the last stronghold of Syunik falls.

wars.name: Gagik I against Syunik
wars.outcome: Gagik I of Armenia took Vayots Dzor, Chahuk and part of Tsghukk from Syunik during his reign (989-1020).

wars.name: Seljuk invasions of Syunik
wars.outcome: 'In 1064, during the reign of Gregory I, Syunik was invaded'; 'In 1103, the Seljuks captured and destroyed Capan'; the kingdom survived as a shrunken principality to 1170.

wars.name: Atabek siege of Baghk
wars.outcome: The Eldiguzid atabeks besieged the kingdom's last stronghold in 1170.

certainty.note: The page gives no borders; the province boundary of Syunik is drawn soft for the whole life.
